critical_code_review_comments: Budget.jsx now ~530 lines and still concentrates many concerns (EditableCell, SiteCell, HiddenIndicator, drag-select, context menu, column model, keyboard nav, click-outside). Approaching 700-line refactor threshold — recommend extracting EditableCell, SiteCell, HiddenIndicator into /components/budget/ and moving COLUMNS + tdBg + isCellEditable into a model file.

The new click-outside useEffect (mousedown) and the existing context-menu useEffect (click) both listen at document level; there is a subtle race when the user right-clicks a th to open context menu: mousedown will fire first and (if no columns selected) is a no-op, then contextmenu sets ctx. Confirmed working but worth a comment for future maintainers.

The click-outside logic depends on e.target.closest('th'); if a future child of <th> uses pointer-events:none, closest may still resolve to the th. OK currently. However, clicks on the row context menu (when open) DO fall outside <th> and will clear selection — this currently is fine because hide flow already resets selectedCols, but be aware if behavior changes.

calc.js comment in line 18 now correctly states 'tanto Frete Enviar quanto Frete Receber SOMAM ao custo' — good. Consider adding a unit test file (frontend/src/lib/__tests__/calc.test.js) covering: (i) frete_receber soma, (ii) PIS por dentro grossup, (iii) ICMS por fora, (iv) mutual exclusion of valor_venda/margem via mode field.

EditableCell shouldFocus is one-shot (useEffect only depends on shouldFocus). If keyboard nav lands twice on the same key without an intermediate null, focus won't re-trigger. Not currently exercised but a token (incrementing focusVersion) would harden it.

input type='number' for currency/percent in pt-BR locale may strip comma decimal separators on some browsers — verify manually that '2,5' inputs work or normalize to '.' before commit in EditableCell.onCommit consumers.
